subject: Merchant portal fee discrepancy on Azure private plan listing
messages:
From: Karen Li <karen.li@greenleafhealth.com>
To: chloe.martin@redwoodinference.com
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 09:12:00 +0000
Subject: Discrepancy: Azure listing shows 20% transaction fee

Hi Chloe,

We pulled the Azure Marketplace private plan listing for our account and noticed the public merchant portal shows a 20% "transaction fee" on invoices. That is not what we signed — our amendment to the private plan (attached to the SOW) specifies a 4% processor fee and no marketplace surcharge.

Finance has already flagged an invoice and is refusing payment until this is resolved. Can you confirm whether this is a display error on Azure's side or if Redwood pushed any changes to the listing? We need a formal note for our AP team and an updated invoice if necessary.

Thanks,
Karen Li
VP Finance, Greenleaf Health
Karen.li@greenleafhealth.com
[Attachment: invoice_202706.pdf (PDF)]

Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 09:25:00 +0000

Ben / Aditya — forwarding Karen's note from Greenleaf. They claim the Azure private plan listing is showing a 20% transaction fee despite our signed amendment (4% processor fee). This is blocking payment.

Quick asks:
- Ben: can you confirm whether we changed pricing on the marketplace feed or the offer manifest?
- Aditya / Legal: if Azure requires evidence, what paperwork do we provide to get the listing corrected and invoices reissued?

I cc'd Laura for procurement/AM visibility. AP is escalating; Karen needs an official statement to share with their vendor/payables.

Chloe

chloe.martin@redwoodinference.com

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: chloe.martin@redwoodinference.com, aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com
Cc: laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com, partnerpm@microsoft.com
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 10:03:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Fwd: Discrepancy: Azure listing shows 20% transaction fee

Thanks Chloe — I did not touch the private plan manifest this week. Our automated feed should have the merchantFee=4% override for the Greenleaf private plan.

I am looping Microsoft Partner PM (partnerpm@microsoft.com) to engage the Azure listing team immediately. Partner PM — can you ask Azure Marketplace Ops to confirm whether the portal or the billing system is surface-ing an incorrect field (transactionFee vs processorFee)? If Azure reissued an invoice with an incorrect surcharge we need an updated invoice and a rollback of the displayed fee. Greenleaf is withholding payment so speed is important.

Planned next steps:
- Microsoft to confirm the source of truth for the merchant fee (listing manifest vs portal UI vs billing pipeline).
- If listing is wrong, Azure to remove incorrect attribute and publish corrected manifest.
- If billing already issued an invoice, Azure to reissue corrected invoice and provide a credit memo.

Ben Carter
Commercial Lead, Cloud Marketplaces | Redwood Inference

From: Microsoft Partner PM <partnerpm@microsoft.com>
To: ben.carter@redwoodinference.com, chloe.martin@redwoodinference.com
Cc: azure-marketplace@microsoft.com
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 14:18:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Merchant portal fee discrepancy on Azure private plan listing

Ben / Chloe — thanks for the ping. I notified Azure Marketplace Ops and asked for a priority investigation. From experience, a mismatch like this typically comes from a malformed offer manifest where the marketplaceFee element was set instead of the processorFee override.

Azure Ops (cc'd) — can you check the Greenleaf Health private plan offer id 7f3b9 and confirm the feed value for fee attributes and whether any recent publish occurred between Jun 10–18? Greenleaf needs a confirmation they can forward to AP.

We can also temporarily pull the listing page until this is corrected to prevent additional confusion.

— Mike (Partner PM)
Microsoft Commercial Partners

From: Azure Marketplace Ops <azure-marketplace@microsoft.com>
To: partnerpm@microsoft.com, ben.carter@redwoodinference.com, chloe.martin@redwoodinference.com
Cc: laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 08:41:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Merchant portal fee discrepancy on Azure private plan listing

Hi team,

Thanks for the details. We investigated offer id 7f3b9 and found that during a publish on Jun 11 an attribute "marketplaceFeePercent" was accidentally populated from a legacy field in the partner feed. The billing pipeline reads "processorFeePercent" for private plan pricing, but the public portal UI was surface-ing "marketplaceFeePercent" in the invoice preview. This was a UI/bind issue — the backend billing for already-finalized invoices remains at 4% (we verified two invoices in the system).

Requested items to remediate and unblock Greenleaf AP:
- Please provide the signed amendment and the SOW that references the 4% processor fee.
- Upload any invoice currently on hold so we can issue a credit memo if necessary.

We will:
- Remove the incorrect public field from the listing (in flight, ETA 6 hours).
- Publish a corrected manifest and force a cache purge for the merchant portal.
- If any invoices were generated with the 20% field in the preview pipeline, we'll coordinate reissue/credit with Azure billing (separate ticket).

Let us know when you upload the docs and we will expedite.

— Azure Marketplace Ops
azure-marketplace@microsoft.com
[Attachment: internal_debug_log_7f3b9.txt (txt)]
